deliverables: Performance optimization, including 2x to 10x improvements in snapshot signing and memory profile and reduced L1 fees through on-chain contract optimization
Operational excellence, including operator runbooks, simpler node configuration, observability and logging, and an improved TUI
Ecosystem support, including production-user and pipeline-integrator requested features, Hydra Alliance facilitation, hackathons, and developer relations
Maintenance and developer experience, including CI, tooling, and technical debt reduction
request.recipient: Input Output Global / IO: Hydra, with Intersect providing administrative treasury governance
request.what: Fund four Hydra v2 workstreams: performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and developer experience/maintenance to deliver a feature-complete and hardened Hydra v2.

claims.claim: Hydra is described as Cardano's only production-grade or production-ready Layer 2 scaling solution.
Hydra has powered or is powering applications including Delta DeFi, Masumi, Hydra Doom, Glacier Drop, Intersect voting infrastructure, VTech Labs, Blockfrost, and Midgard.
The proposal requests ₳5,100,781 and says the funding will be milestone-gated with independent third-party assurance and Intersect administrative treasury governance.
The proposer claims Hydra provides sub-second finality, near-zero or zero internal fees, high throughput, and L1-anchored settlement guarantees.
The proposer claims Cardano L1 currently has over two hours of finality, approximately $0.17 per payment transaction, and roughly 7 to 10 TPS, making high-performance use cases uncompetitive on L1.
The performance workstream targets 2x to 10x improvements in snapshot signing and memory profile plus reduced L1 fees through on-chain contract optimization.
The proposer claims Hydra applications can increase L1 settlement usage and may create treasury or reward-pot revenue through head lifecycle transactions and optionally routed internal head fees.
The proposer claims without Hydra or if this work slips, existing or prospective high-performance builders may migrate to competing chains and Cardano may lose adoption opportunities.

The proposal says it aligns with treasury KPIs for TVL, monthly active users, monthly transactions, throughput capacity, reliability and uptime, annual protocol revenue, and with Pillars 1, 2, 4, and 5.
The document links to a PDF version of the proposal through an IPNS/CID URL.

summary: The proposal requests ₳5,100,781 for Hydra v2 hardening across performance, operations, ecosystem support, and developer experience, but most adoption, economic-impact, and competitive claims are asserted in the anchor text rather than evidenced with detailed budget, feasibility, alternatives, or failure-mode analysis.
